subject: Technical control debrief + artifact index for Secure SDLC review
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Elena Caldwell <elena@caldwellrisk.com>, audit@finbank.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Technical control debrief + artifact index for Secure SDLC review

Hi Elena / FinBank audit team,

Thanks for the intake call this morning. Attached is a compact index of the Secure SDLC artifacts we discussed so you can confirm what you want in the assessor package. I put the most frequently requested items first.

Quick index (attached files and brief contents):
- evidence_index.csv (CSV manifest: artifact id, short description, redaction notes)
- code_review_samples.patch (three anonymized PR diffs showing reviewer comments, approvals, and merge timestamps)
- ci_pipeline_snapshot.zip (screenshots + run metadata from a representative pipeline run; automated test reports redacted where needed)

We can provide additional artifacts on request (full PR history, branch protection audit logs, ephemeral runner inventory) but wanted to confirm this baseline set before sharing broader access. Please let us know: 1) if any items need further redaction, 2) whether you prefer a shared Drive folder or S3 bundle, and 3) target deadline for the package.

I’m cc’ing Lauren and Jonas to help triage any redaction or access requests.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Security Assurance
Redwood Inference
Attachment: evidence_index.csv (CSV manifest)
Attachment: code_review_samples.patch (text/patch)
Attachment: ci_pipeline_snapshot.zip (zip)

From: Elena Caldwell <elena@caldwellrisk.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical control debrief + artifact index for Secure SDLC review

Hi Irene — thanks for the quick turnaround and the manifest. A few clarifying items from the assessor side:

1) Redactions: the CSV manifest looks fine but we will need reviewer names replaced with initials in the code review samples (PII rule). Can you confirm you can provide a redacted version where usernames are pseudonymized?
2) Pipeline selection: for ci_pipeline_snapshot.zip we need the run ID and timing so we can map to the build logs referenced in the SOC 2 narrative. Please include the pipeline run id and the commit SHA used.
3) Access model: shared Drive is preferred for the first pass (pdf/png artifacts) and then a secure S3 link for bulk logs if needed. Please send the Drive link with view-only access and enable link expiration.
4) Attestations: our SOC 2 assessor also requested a short attestation (one paragraph) from engineering that the snapshots are representative and not synthetic. Do you have a standard statement you can sign?

If you can get the redacted samples and Drive link to me by EOD Friday (12/11) we should be on schedule for initial review next week.

Regards,
Elena Caldwell
Senior Assessor, Caldwell Risk
Attachment: none

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Technical control debrief + artifact index — redaction / attest request (internal)

Folks — forwarding Elena’s asks. Proposed plan:

- Lauren: can your team run a quick scrub to pseudonymize reviewer IDs in code_review_samples.patch and produce a mapping file (internal only) that we keep offline? Target: today EOD.
- Jonas: can you pull the pipeline run metadata (run id, commit SHA, test coverage summary) for the representative run referenced in ci_pipeline_snapshot.zip and confirm there are no credential strings in logs? If there are transient secrets, we should replace them with <REDACTED>.
- I’ll draft the short attestation paragraph for engineering sign-off and circulate for signature (DocuSign or simple email attestation).

Two additional notes: 1) Do not include any user PII in the Drive share; only pseudonyms. 2) We will attach a minimal README in the Drive that enumerates redaction steps and the internal mapping location.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate uploads once we have the scrubbed artifacts.

—Irene

Attachments in this email: scrubbed_ci_screenshots.zip (zip, redacted), code_review_samples.redacted.patch (text/patch). A short engineering attestation is below — please confirm whether you prefer DocuSign or an emailed attestation and we’ll get it signed.

Irene Choi

From: Elena Caldwell <elena@caldwellrisk.com>

Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical control debrief + artifact index for Secure SDLC review

Irene / team — received and reviewed the drive snapshot. The redactions look good and the run metadata matches what we expected. Two small asks before we close the intake: 1) please replace one remaining full email address in the code patch with a pseudonym (we flagged it in PR#2), and 2) include a one-line note in the README about how long the pipeline snapshots are retained (retention window).

If you can push that updated patch and a README update by Monday EOD we’ll be able to finalize the assessor packet and proceed to the SOC 2 evidence mapping. DocuSign attestation is fine — please send the envelope to assessor@caldwellrisk.com.

Thanks,
Elena Caldwell
Senior Assessor, Caldwell Risk
FinBank SOC 2 review lead
